applicability.description: Validates acyclicity of graph-structured JSON records under variable schemas (nodes/edges, vertices/links, arcs, etc.) by normalizing field names via a field_map before Kahn topological sort with DFS cycle extraction.
requires_markers: graph record dict containing node/edge lists
claims: T0:deterministic output regardless of input edge order via sorted Kahn queue
T1:reports valid:true with stable topological order, or valid:false with extracted cycle path

limitations: does not support multi-edges or hyperedges
does not validate schema beyond field-name resolution
nodes referenced only by edges are auto-promoted into the node set
field_map defaults are best-effort; custom schemas require explicit mapping
